title: 2.7 Volume of solids

1.title: Question: how much does it hold?

q.Q1: Q1. A cylindrical water tank has radius 1.4 m and height 2 m. Find its capacity in litres (π = 22/7).

q.Q2: Q2. A cone-shaped funnel has radius 6 cm and height 14 cm. Find its volume (π = 22/7).
q.Q3: Q3. A pyramid has a rectangular base 9 m by 6 m and a height of 10 m. Find its volume.

q.Q4: Q4. Find the volume of a ball of diameter 21 cm (π = 22/7).
q.Q5: Q5. A metal sphere is melted and recast into small cubes. Which quantity stays the same?

q.Q6: Q6. A bucket is a frustum of a cone with radii 14 cm and 7 cm and height 21 cm. Find its capacity in litres (π = 22/7).
q.Q7: Q7. A solid metal cylinder of radius 6 cm and height 8 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm. How many spheres are made?

q.Q8: Q8. Find the capacity of the tank in litres and how many days it would supply a school using 1500 litres a day (π = 22/7).

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. Write the formula for the volume of a cone.
